scope: Post-live publication review of direct compiler authority; no provider calls
finding: The optional three-argument compiler path could retain a caller-added embedded private locator when its scalar was approved. Production Discovery already supplied independently reviewed profile targets.
fix: Make reviewed_targets mandatory, reject every target not matching that map, and remove the legacy exact-private-value fallback. Direct callers migrated; negative tests retain the original pre-mutation target map.
production_behavior: Discovery already passed profile.targets; its reviewed-target path is unchanged. No claim that prior live runs executed the later file bytes.
new_permanent_tests: No redundant API-wiring test added; existing embedded-locator regressions and direct-call tests use the required authority. Before/after reproduction was an offline throwaway program.
lsp_references: Python server returned -32601 unsupported; scoped grep identified all constructor callers.
